question: Mankind’s survival, according to the passage, solely depends on _________ .
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Explanation:** The passage makes it clear that **the survival of humans and life on Earth is intimately linked with the health of the soil.**
 
• This is evident in the line: **“our very survival as humans – and life on this planet – is intimately linked with the health of a thin layer of soil enveloping the earth.”**
